name: PER_ROLES_DN
description: Stores the roles that are used in the system.  Data normally denormalized from LDAP via the Identity Governance Framework apis (IGF).

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: ROLE_GUID
columns.description: ?Globally Unique Identifier for the Role

columns.name: ABSTRACT_ROLE
columns.description: ?Flag to Indicate it is an Abstract Role

columns.name: JOB_ROLE
columns.description: ?Flag to Indicate it is an Job Role

columns.name: DATA_ROLE
columns.description: ?Flag to Indicate it is an Data Role

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: ?Flag to Indicate it is an Active Role

columns.name: ROLE_COMMON_NAME
columns.description: The Common Name (CN) defined within LDAP.

columns.name: MULTITENANCY_COMMON_NAME
columns.description: The Multitenancy Common Name Defined in LDAP

columns.name: ROLE_DISTINGUISHED_NAME
columns.description: The Distinguished Name (DN) defined within LDAP - Contains group information etc. to provide a unique name.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DELEGATION_ALLOWED
columns.description: ?Flag to Indicate it is the Role can be delegated

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: EXTERNAL_ID

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ROLE
columns.description: ?Flag to Indicate it is an External Role

columns.name: DUTY_ROLE
columns.description: DUTY_ROLE
